package.description: Cross-county district view. Precincts assigned wholly to the district containing their representative point (split precincts are not apportioned). Statewide races and the district's own race merged from member counties; counties on different data vintages contribute different races. Own-race results from years before the 2021 plans were contested under the prior plan's boundaries.

amendments.what: Added Hunt County's CD-3 U.S. Representative results (2022, 2024) as county-level hunt:ALL aggregates.
amendments.method: Hunt = official full-district total (Texas SOS via Wikipedia/Ballotpedia) minus our Collin portion. Verified: derived Hunt 2024 = 78.3% Self / 21.7% Srivastava, matching the reported Hunt County 2024 result.

amendments.what: Replaced Hunt County's DERIVED CD-3 U.S. Representative totals (2022, 2024) with Hunt County's OFFICIAL precinct-level results from its Clarity Elections portal.
amendments.method: fetch_clarity_results.py → results.enr.clarityelections.com/TX/Hunt (2022 election 115635, 2024 election 122429); split ballot-style precincts summed to base voting precinct. Official Hunt totals: 2024 Self 31,457 / Srivastava 8,721; 2022 Self 20,617 / Srivastava 5,396 / Claytor 495.
amendments.note: Supersedes the earlier subtraction-derived estimate (2024 had been 31,473 / 8,731). Precinct codes are Hunt's voting precincts; map still shows Hunt as a county outline (VTD geometry unaligned).
